articles.summary: AbCellera (Nasdaq: ABCL) announced that the Company will present at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference on September 9, 2026. A live audio webcast of the presentation may be accessed through a link that will be posted on AbCellera's Investor Relations website . A replay will be available through the same link following the presentation. About AbCellera Biologics Inc. AbCellera (Nasdaq: ABCL) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on discovering and developing first-in-class antibody-based medicines in the areas of endocrinology, women’s health, immunology, oncology, and more. For more information, please visit www.abcellera.com .
